Description: 1) Original intent: the Query Contract (KRYL-1372) selects and locks the subject; entity resolution is a later step whose result is attribution (RESOLVED or UNRESOLVED), and analysis continues either way. 2) Acceptance criteria: for a selected subject whose entity is not in the registry, no guest-facing surface says 'No subject resolved' or 'No resolvable subject'; each states the subject and that its entity is unresolved; qa_query_corpus.mjs passes. 3) Current implementation state: the brief headline, sentence and rows were fixed; the Evidence row (structuralbrief.jsx), the BY DOMAIN header and SIGNAL heading (domainsubstratetabs.jsx) and the Target Packet line (targetpacket.jsx) still tested kind === ENTITY and printed the no-subject copy. Reported by the Founder with a Subcritical Systems run on localhost 2026-10-08. 4) Dependencies: KRYL-1372; KRYL-1380 (Spike, entity admission for unregistered names). 5) Superseded by a newer ticket: none. 6) Maps to current product model: yes.
